levels.surface: أحمد بن جعفر بن محمد الهمدانی

notes: A plain «حدثنا / قال حدثنا» chain of eight names ending at the Companion Salman; the Prophet's words are the matn and the blessing after his name is not part of any surface.
Diacritics are dropped; the Persian yeh (ی) is kept as the text writes it.
